summary: Frontend-only retest of the 14 iteration_32 i18n issues, run on the mobile web preview at 375x667 with the autoT cache cleared before each check. FIXED: track-order header and all 6 steps (en/de/zh); merchant bookings tabs and badges; delivery-settings tabs; affiliate-apply hero; points date locale (de 25.9.2026); warranties expired card (no days-left text, grey bar); driver alerts wrapped in tSync; create-return LTR (en: left-aligned, chevron-back); checkout carriers use name_en and a translated city; chamber status, draws, participants, prizes and Winners; draw screen in de/zh. PARTIAL or NOT FIXED: service-bookings list badge still Arabic; drivers 'ر.س' still Arabic; support-settings 'بدون + أو 00' sub still Arabic and en 'العنوان' = 'Title'; chamber detail 'All Participants (n)' is hardcoded English (also shown in ar); loyalty-history shows the raw key 'external_program'. The en dictionary entries are NOT corrected: 'نافذة السحب' = 'Withdrawal Window', 'تاريخ السحب' = 'Withdrawal date', 'ساعات اليوم' = 'Hours of the day', 'ربحت {0} ر.س' = 'You won'. The de/zh entries are corrected. zh role names are NOT re-translated: the backend Mongo translation cache still returns stale values. NEW: competition/[id].tsx has many hardcoded English strings on a customer screen. Regression: 0 pageerrors and no blank pages across about 90 page loads (customer/merchant/chamber/driver in ar/en/de/zh/he). No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: Stale zh cache entries are served with cached:true: 'المخزون فقط' returns '库存仅有' (should be 仅库存), 'مدير فرع' returns '经理' (should be 分店经理), 'إدارة فرع كاملة' returns '完整的分支管理' (should be 完整的分店管理). The preset role names and descriptions come from backend/server.py:1355-1359 and are not in i18n-generated.json, so /merchant/roles in zh still shows the wrong text.

ui_bugs.issue: In i18n-generated.json only de/zh were fixed. en still has 'نافذة السحب' = 'Withdrawal Window' (draw.tsx:116, shows WITHDRAWAL WINDOW), 'تاريخ السحب' = 'Withdrawal date' (competition/[id].tsx:94, chamber.tsx:163), 'ساعات اليوم' = 'Hours of the day' (merchant/team.tsx:61) and 'ربحت {0} ر.س' = 'You won {0} SAR' (driver/index.tsx:66). It should be Draw window / Draw date / Hours today / You earned {0} SAR.

Shown in every language, including zh/ar: 'Still open'/'Ended'/'Coming soon' (competition/[id].tsx:85), '{n} user' (:95), 'Answer 70% of the questions to join the draw' (:107), 'Answer Questions (n Q)' (:110), 'Participants (n)' (:116), 'Answer 70% of the questions to join' (:166), 'Next'/'Submit' (:178), and Alerts 'Congratulations!'/'Sorry!'/'You scored...'/'Error' (:47-49,59).
The list status pill renders STATUS_FLOW label raw, so en/de show 'مكتمل', 'قيد الإصلاح', 'قيد الاستلام'. Only the modal buttons (:140) were wrapped. Reference: app/merchant/service-bookings.tsx:81
'All Participants ({n})' is hardcoded English and shows in ar too. Reference: app/chamber.tsx:212

In en/de the page still reads 'Commission: 5 ر.س per order', because the literal ' ر.س' is concatenated into the tf arg. Reference: app/merchant/drivers.tsx:52. Alerts at :26 and :30 ('Required', 'Name and phone required', 'Created') are hardcoded English.

f.sub is rendered raw ('بدون + أو 00' in en/de); the dict already has 'Without + or 00'. Reference: app/merchant/support-settings.tsx:73. Dict 'العنوان' en is 'Title' (should be 'Address'; de is already Adresse) and zh is '标题' (should be 地址).

Source 'external_program' is not in SOURCE_LABEL, so the raw key 'external_program' is shown. Dict 'استبدال' = Replacement/Ersatz/替换 (should be Redemption/Einlösung/兑换). 'تقييم' en is 'reviews' (lowercase plural). Reference: app/loyalty-history.tsx:23-27,87

The stat 'المشاركات' (participations) is translated as Posts / Beiträge / 帖子. zh 'عرض التفاصيل والسحب' is '查看详情与提现' (提现 = cash withdrawal; should be 查看详情与抽奖). en '{0} مشارك' gives '26 Participant' (should be plural). Reference: app/chamber.tsx:112,129
en '{0} موظف' gives '5 employee' (should be plural).
In de/zh, 'Bank Transfer', 'Cash on Delivery' and 'Internal Store Points' stay English (ar is correct).

integration_issues.issue: Observation: Regular delivery showed 25 SAR in en/ar but 10 SAR in de/zh for the same cart and address on consecutive loads. Possibly a location or fee-calculation race. Not i18n-related; verify.

critical_code_review_comments: The static dictionary takes precedence over /api/translate, but strings missing from it (e.g. DB preset role names) fall back to a persistent Mongo cache that never invalidates, so bad LLM translations stick forever. Consider an admin purge or a version bump.
tf() args containing literal Arabic units (drivers.tsx:52) bypass translation; units should be translated separately.

success_rate.frontend: ~65% of the iteration_32 items fully fixed (9 fixed, 4 partial, 2 not fixed; en dictionary and zh roles not fixed); regression 100% (0 crashes)

IDs: order 6ab6b8cbdfe07c92e87b8bce, competition 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12bc, chamber comp 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12be (/draw?id=). create-return has no returnable products for the customer, so the item chevron is unverified.
rca_of_issue: en dictionary: the fix was applied only to the de/zh keys of the affected entries; the en values were left untouched. zh roles: role names/descriptions are Arabic DB strings missing from the static dict, so they hit /api/translate, whose Mongo cache (translate.py _cache_get) returns the earlier bad LLM output; 're-translated on demand' never happens because the cache is hit first.
